# Frederick Armando — Lead Product Designer

> Portfolio of Frederick Armando, a Lead Product Designer based in France. He turns complex user, business and technical constraints into clear, usable and measurable product experiences — with a focus on AI-powered products, conversational UX, design systems, SaaS and B2B/B2C/B2E mobile and web applications.

## Profile

- Name: Frederick Armando (also: Frédérick Armando)
- Role: Lead Product Designer
- Location: France
- Availability: open to freelance, consulting and Lead Product Designer missions
- Focus: complex digital products, AI experiences, mobile UX, accessibility, product strategy

## Key expertise

- Product Design & Product Strategy
- Conversational AI & Conversational UI (chatbots, proactive notifications)
- Generative UI (GenUI)
- Mobile UX (iOS / Android) and responsive web
- Design Systems
- B2B, B2C and B2E products
- Accessibility (WCAG)
- UX research, product discovery & UX audits
- Prototyping and design handoff

## Case studies

- [Michelin Tire Assistant](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/michelin-tire-assistant): B2C AI chatbot turned from a passive support tool into a proactive engagement and conversion lever. Impact: +18% open rate and 21.3% purchase intent.
- [Michelin MyXpert](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/michelin-myxpert): B2B/B2E native app centralizing Michelin technical expertise for global sales teams. Impact: 3 legacy apps decommissioned, target 20,000 users.
- [Masteos](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/masteos): B2C PropTech — simplifying turnkey real-estate investing. Impact: +32% finalized investments.
- [Helios](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/helios): B2E internal back-office for Masteos operations. Impact: internal NPS boosted from 6.5 to 8.7.
- [Kirrk](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/kirrk): B2B2C car-sharing & fleet-management ecosystem (SaaS + B2B/B2C apps). Impact: fleet utilization > 80%.
- [Mobioos](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/mobioos): B2B SaaS No-Code platform translating heavy technical architecture (UML, AI generation) into a chatbot + drag-and-drop customization experience.

## Coming soon

- [Upcoming case studies](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/upcoming-case-studies): New case studies are in preparation, covering highly secure healthcare interfaces and performance-driven e-commerce experiences. Contact Frederick for an early preview.
